coreMemory.english: adv. used to say that something may be true
coreMemory.structure: perhaps because /pərˈhæps bɪkɔz/（也许因为）；perhaps we should /pərˈhæps wi ʃʊd/（也许我们应该）；perhaps not /pərˈhæps nɑt/（也许不会）；perhaps the most important /pərˈhæps ðə moʊst ɪmpɔrtənt/（也许最重要的）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ a perhaps answer → ✅ use perhaps to modify the statement；❌ perhapsly → ✅ perhaps

commonErrors.right: use perhaps to modify the statement
commonErrors.note: 副词通常不直接放在名词前作定语，应根据句意放在动词、形容词或整个分句旁。
perhaps 本身已经是本卡要学的形式，不要再次机械添加 -ly。

synonyms.difference: perhaps 是本卡核心搭配 “perhaps because” 中的中性常用选择；maybe 含义接近，但语体、宾语范围和固定搭配可能不同，不能机械互换。
